ai_summary: This document discloses that Andrew Yule & Co. Ltd., a Government of India enterprise, has appointed Shri Singhai Sanjay Jain as a Non-official Independent Director to its Board, effective August 17, 2026, for a three-year term, as directed by the President of India. This routine corporate governance update is expected to enhance board oversight and financial expertise, given Shri Jain's extensive background as a Chartered Accountant with over 30 years of experience in finance and law. There are no apparent red flags or disclosed conflicts of interest associated with this appointment.
